# one-pi-one-price

Canonical Claim:
A native Pi payment on the Pi Mainnet ledger carries no observable information about whether its units were mined or bought. Mined π = Exchange π = π from any source. Pi's native asset is fungible.

## Summary
This repository provides a source-verified, dependency-free, reproducible proof of Pi Network native asset fungibility. It explains, through the Law of One Price and Arbitrage, why identical freely-tradable assets converge to a single price in open markets.

## Core Thesis
- One currency = One asset = One price in an open market
- Mined Pi and bought Pi (CEX withdrawals) are the same native asset on Mainnet
- No origin field exists on-chain, in SDK, or in observed transaction data
- Fungibility (interchangeability) != Fairness (distribution justice)
- Native asset != IOU
- Arbitrage enforces price unity across linked markets
- "What is fair" differs from "what the market does"
